title: Detecting Hallucinations and Recovering Verified Answers in Arabic Islamic Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2608.03720v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models can generate fluent responses to Islamic questions while introducing factual errors that are difficult to identify. This paper presents our system for \textsc{HalluScoring 2026} Task 2.1, \textit{Islamic Hallucination Detection and Find the Truth}. The task requires a unified two-step prediction: determining whether an Arabic answer generated by an LLM is hallucinated and selecting the verified answer from six closely related candidate options. We use the Islamic knowledge dataset provided by the shared task, which contains 600 question--answer instances, including 341 hallucinated and 259 non-hallucinated answers. Our system is based on the fine-tuned \texttt{google/gemma-4-12B-it} model and uses deterministic decoding during inference. The generated outputs are normalized to extract the hallucination label and the selected option. The system achieves a Macro-F1 score of 0.928 and a label accuracy of 0.935 for

translated_title: 检测阿拉伯语伊斯兰问答中的幻觉并恢复经过验证的答案
translated_abstract: 大语言模型能够对伊斯兰相关问题生成流畅的回答，但同时可能引入难以识别的事实性错误。本文介绍了我们参加 HalluScoring 2026 任务 2.1（伊斯兰幻觉检测与寻找真相）的系统。该任务要求进行统一的两步预测：判断由大语言模型生成的阿拉伯语回答是否存在幻觉，并从六个高度相关的候选选项中选出经过验证的正确答案。我们使用共享任务提供的伊斯兰知识数据集，其中包含600个问答实例，包括341个幻觉回答和259个非幻觉回答。我们的系统基于微调后的 google/gemma-4-12B-it 模型，并在推理过程中使用确定性解码。生成的输出经过规范化处理以提取幻觉标签和所选选项。该系统在幻觉检测上实现了0.928的宏平均F1分数和0.935的标签准确率。
tldr: 本文基于微调的Gemma-4-12B-it模型构建了一个统一的两步系统，用于检测大语言模型在阿拉伯语伊斯兰问答中产生的幻觉并从六个候选选项中恢复经过验证的正确答案，取得了0.928的Macro-F1和0.935的标签准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a unified two-step system based on a fine-tuned Gemma-4-12B-it model for detecting LLM hallucinations in Arabic Islamic question answering and recovering verified answers from six candidate options, achieving a Macro-F1 of 0.928 and a label accuracy of 0.935.
